summary: Reduced rescue and fire fighting cover at EGUN, with three vehicles carrying 7,500 gallons of foam agent.
text:
RFFS CAPABILITY AMBER, 03 VEHICLES/7500 GALLONS OF AGENT REDUCING

B-52, 767). NFPA CAT 9 (KC-10, E-4, MD-11, 747, 777, VC-25) 
AND NFPA CAT 10 (C5, 787-8I) ARE AT REDUCED LVL OF SER. NFPA CAT 7
